title: subscribe delivers published topics
description: Verifies that published topics prefixed with kaava:topic/ are delivered to subscribe() callbacks unwrapped.
given: A client with a subscribe() listener registered
when: An event arrives with the kaava:topic/ prefix
then: The callback receives the unwrapped value and the 'from' instance id; unsubscribe stops delivery
impl_ref: packages/bridge/src/client.test.ts::delivers a published topic to subscribe(), unwrapped, and stops on unsubscribe
